item.title: NAJERIYA A YAU: Daga Alƙawari Zuwa Mulki, Yadda Siyasa Ke Sauya Manufa - Aminiya
item.description: Duk bayan shekaru huɗu, Najeriya na ƙara yin zabe kuma ko wanne lokaci ’yan takara kan ɗauki alƙawurika. Ko shekaru nawa waɗanda ake zabe ke buƙata don cika alƙawuran da suka ɗauka?

item.title: Tsohon hadimin Ganduje, Salihu Yakasai, ya koma ADC - Aminiya
item.description: Tsohon mai bai wa tsohon gwamnan Kano shawara kan harkokin yaɗa labarai, Salihu Tanko Yakasai, ya sanar da sauya sheƙa daga jam’iyya mai mulki ta APC zuwa ADC (African Democratic Congress).

item.title: Kakakin Majalisar Zamfara da mambobi 12 sun koma APC - Aminiya
item.description: Kakakin Majalisar Dokokin Jihar Zamfara, Bilyaminu Moriki, ya fice daga jam’iyyar PDP zuwa APC, tare da wasu mambobin majalisar guda 12.

item.title: Tashar Arewa24 ta dawo da shirin Zaɓi Biyu a zango na biyu - Aminiya
item.description: Tashar AREWA24 ta sanar da dawo da shahararren shirin nan na wasan kwaikwayo mai dogon zango “Zaɓi Biyu” bayan azumin watan azumi na Ramadan.

item.title: Abin da ya hana ni tarbar Sarki Sanusi a Bikin Hawan Nasarawa — Gwamnan Kano - Aminiya
item.description: A kwanakin nan ana ci gaba da yaɗa jita-jitar cewa Gwamnan Kano, Abba Kabir Yusuf ya yi watsi da Sarki Muhammadu Sanusi II ta hanyar ƙin halartar Bikin Hawan Nasarawa da aka gudanar a gidan gwamnatin jihar.

item.title: Kwankwaso na tattaunawa da jam’iyyun ADC da NDC - Aminiya
item.description: Ƙungiyar Kwankwasiyya ta tabbatar da cewa jagoran NNPP kuma ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa a Zaɓen 2023, Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, na ci gaba da tattaunawa da jam’iyyun ADC da kuma NDC gabanin zaɓen 2027.

item.title: HOTUNA: Yadda aka tsaurara matakan tsaro yayin gurfanar da El-Rufai a Kotu - Aminiya
item.description: A wannan Talatar ce Hukumar Yaƙi da Cin Hanci da Rashawa ICPC ta gurfanar da tsohon gwamnan Jihar Kaduna, Nasir El-Rufai, a gaban Babbar Kotun Tarayya da ke Kaduna bisa zargin aikata laifukan da suka shafi karkatar da kuɗaɗe da kadarorin gwamnati ba bisa ƙa’ida ba.

item.title: EFCC ta ƙwace gidajen Malami a Abuja - Aminiya
item.description: Jami’an Hukumar EFCC mai yaƙi da masu yi wa tattalin arziki zagon ƙasa sun yi wa gidajen tsohon Ministan Shari’a, Abubakar Malami ƙawanya a wani yunkuri na ƙwace muhallin tsohon Babban Lauyan na Najeriya.

item.title: Kotu ta ƙi ba da belin El-Rufai - Aminiya
item.description: Babbar Kotun Tarayya da ke zamanta a Kaduna ta yi watsi da buƙatar bayar da belin tsohon gwamnan jihar, Nasir El-Rufai, bayan da aka gurfanar da shi a gabanta a ranar Talata.

item.title: Muna fama da ƙarancin jami’ai mata a Kano — NDLEA - Aminiya
item.description: Hukumar Yaƙi da Sha da Fataucin Miyagun Kwayoyi ta Kasa (NDLEA), tana fama da ƙarancin jami’ai mata a Jihar Kano, lamarin da ta bayyana a matsayin babban ƙalubale da ke kawo cikas a ayyukanta.
